# Results (generated by `python -m ubi_sim.run`)

Population: 1000 agents, seed 42.

## Baseline calibration (psi = 1)

| Scenario | Tax rate (%) | Total hours | Labor cost index | Revenue gap (%) | Mean consumption | Gini (consumption) | Mean utility | SD utility | Bottom-decile utility | Δ mean utility |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No UBI | 20.00 | 399,075 | 1.000 | +0.000000 | 83,951 | 0.185 | 10.953 | 0.327 | 10.394 | +0.0000 |
| UBI Low | 25.32 | 389,786 | 1.024 | +0.000000 | 81,767 | 0.177 | 10.953 | 0.305 | 10.440 | +0.0008 |
| UBI High | 43.55 | 354,956 | 1.124 | +0.000000 | 73,469 | 0.147 | 10.937 | 0.233 | 10.568 | -0.0159 |

## Recalibrated model (psi = 15.36; the average agent works 40% of the time endowment)

| Scenario | Tax rate (%) | Total hours | Labor cost index | Revenue gap (%) | Mean consumption | Gini (consumption) | Mean utility | SD utility | Bottom-decile utility | Δ mean utility |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No UBI | 20.00 | 160,000 | 1.000 | +0.000000 | 33,981 | 0.184 | 10.052 | 0.324 | 9.500 | +0.0000 |
| UBI Low | 33.88 | 149,963 | 1.067 | +0.000000 | 31,609 | 0.163 | 10.049 | 0.268 | 9.611 | -0.0029 |
| UBI Mid | 50.91 | 135,909 | 1.177 | +0.000000 | 28,225 | 0.132 | 10.018 | 0.202 | 9.706 | -0.0342 |

**UBI High (B = 20,000) is infeasible**: the most revenue any flat tax can raise is 19,974,393 (at a 75% rate), below the 28,365,643 needed.
